## Summary

Describe the change and link related issues.

## Validation

List commands run and their results. Explain any checks you could not run or pre-existing failures. Add sanitized screenshots for visible changes.

## Compatibility and risks

Mention API changes, deployment/migration steps, dependency changes, and privacy or security implications.

## Checklist

- [ ] My contribution is within scope and I have the right to submit it under LICENSE.
- [ ] Required creator credit and existing third-party notices are preserved.
- [ ] The change introduces no advertising, selling, or paid access.
- [ ] Tests and documentation are updated where relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, signed media URLs, or downloaded media are included.
